summary: DoubleVerify Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing entry into an Agreement and Plan of Merger with Neptune BidCo US Inc. (Parent) and Wallace Merger Sub Inc. Merger Sub will merge into DoubleVerify, which will survive as a wholly owned subsidiary of Parent, taking the company private. The filing does not disclose financial terms such as per-share price or premium. The board will seek stockholder approval via a proxy statement and special meeting. A press release was attached. Watch for the definitive proxy statement detailing price, recommendation, and advisor names; risk-arb depends on announced terms and regulatory timeline.
